chunks: Al-Haysam asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) — and I was in his presence — about the words of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:
'And signs; and by the star they are being guided' [Quran 16:16]
So he said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah's blessings be upon him and his family) [said]: 'The star and the signs — they are the Imams (peace be upon them).'

key_terms.الأئمة: The Imams — the divinely appointed successors who are the living signs of God
key_terms.العلامات: Signs/landmarks — interpreted esoterically as the Imams who guide humanity
key_terms.النجم: The star — in the Quranic context a celestial guide; here interpreted as the Prophet or the Imams

ai.seo_question: What does Quran 16:16 mean by 'star' and 'signs' according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) interprets the Quranic verse 16:16, which refers to stars and signs as guides, by citing the Prophet's teaching that these are allegorical references to the Imams of the Ahlulbayt. This interpretation is part of the broader Shia theological understanding that divine guidance passes through the Imams, who are living signs of God on earth. The original audience of early Shia scholars understood this as validating the Imamate as an extension of Quranic guidance.

en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al Washha, from Asbaat Bin Salim who said, 
‘Al-Haysam asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> and I was in his<sup>asws</sup> presence, about the Words of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic
[16:16] And Signs; and by the star they are being guided
, so he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The ‘star’ and the ‘signs’, they are the Imams<sup>asws</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 2. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from MuAlia ibn Muhammad from al-Washsha’ from Asbat ibn Salim who has said that Haythamm asked Imam abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.), while I was there, about the meaning of the words of Allah, “Through the signs and with the star people do find their way.” [16:16]
The Imams (a.s.) said, “Star is the Messenger of Allah (s.a) and the signs are the Imams (a.s.)”
